title: 第一卷 第21章 难道他还是一名剑修第一卷 第22章 原为人族执剑
lines: 神血阁，乃是无相门麾下的核心部门，专门负责研究各种特殊体质与血脉。
无相门麾下许多强大的相兽战士，异种修士，都是在神血阁中培育而成。
这是大相帝国强大的根本，也是帝国打造超级兽族特种军队的核心兵来源。
见徐志华神色激荡，柳庆达愈发兴奋，继续说道：
“徐大司长，这一次，您和天山郡无相司，可是要立大功了！
根据属下的调查，那研究体是探宝队在神魔遗迹中挖出来的，体质极为特殊。
在神血阁作为研究体时，被评为甲级，能够吞噬各类兽血与灵药，潜力无穷！”
“他原本已经死透了，可被送来黑山姥姥这里之后，竟离奇复活，还闹出了不少风波。”
说到这里，柳庆达转头看向黑山姥姥，眼神中带着几分确认。
黑山姥姥双目微微眯起，语气带着几分诧异：“哦？你是说，有研究体在我这里死而复生？”
柳庆达重重点头，语气愈发肯定：“正是！属下已经核实过，此事千真万确！”
徐志华的目光愈发炽热，呼吸也变得愈发粗重！
甲等神血研究体死而复生，这若是能将其重新掌控，绝对是一件足以惊动相京的大功！
徐志华心中清楚，这死而复生的研究体，必定是培育成功了。
那研究体身上，定然有着逆天的能力！
甚至有可能改变整个大相帝国的未来！
他再也无法保持镇定，当即拉着柳庆达，与黑山姥姥三人，互相核对各自掌握的信息。
半晌，黑山姥姥双目眯起，语气中带着震惊，喃喃自语：“怪不得了，当时那陈家丫头逃跑的时候，身边还跟着一个十分奇怪的胖胖少年。
他身上的污染灵力极少，神体非常的纯净，当初本座怒急攻心，没能多想······
如今看来，那少年恐怕就是那个成功的研究体！”
听到黑山姥姥的话，徐志华呼吸愈发急促，再也按捺不住心中的激动，低吼一声：
话音未落，他便带着柳庆达匆匆离开了。
黑山岩洞，连一句告辞都未曾留下。
“该死！竟然错过了如此逆天大药！”
黑山姥姥看着两人匆匆离去的背影，气得厉声大吼。
那个胖胖少年，本是她预定的晚餐！
只可惜被陈家丫头和陈国道搅了局，如今竟成了无相门的囊中之物。
“去他娘的陈家！”
黑山姥姥怒火中烧，却偏偏有心无力——被那僵尸打伤的伤势，至今仍未复原，根本无法追击。
徐志华一离开黑山，便立刻命令柳庆达召集周边县城的无相司人手，火速在所有县城、乡镇村落以及营地，全方位搜寻那个研究体，以及那名执剑余孽的下落。
怀山县管辖之下共有十三个城镇，每个城镇都设有主政官，也就是镇守大人。
同时配备一个执法司，和一支无相司小队。
接到柳庆达的命令后，十三个小镇的衙役与无相司小队，共计上千人手迅速调动起来。
一时间，整个怀山县风起云涌，人心惶惶。
数日之后，徐志华根据收集到的情报整理分析，快速锁定了目标范围——武桥镇管辖区域内！
有消息称，青山村一带疑似出现了一头僵尸！
而那僵尸的行事作风，大概率就是他们要找的执剑余孽。
于是，徐志华与柳庆达立刻召集了怀山县的精锐力量——两百名骑兵，浩浩荡荡地朝着武桥镇疾驰而去。
这两百名骑兵所乘坐的马匹，并非普通马匹，而是被灵力污染过的黑鳞马。
content_en:
The Divine Blood Pavilion is the core department under the Wuxiang Sect and is responsible for researching various special physiques and bloodlines.
Many of the powerful phase beast warriors and alien monks under the Wuxiang Sect were cultivated in the Divine Blood Pavilion.
This is the foundation of the Prime Minister's empire's strength, and it is also the core source of soldiers for the empire to build a super orc special army.
Seeing Xu Zhihua's excited expression, Liu Qingda became even more excited and continued:
"Director Xu, this time, you have no relationship with Tianshan County, but you are going to make a great contribution!
According to the investigation of the subordinates, the research body was dug out by the treasure hunting team in the ruins of gods and demons, and has an extremely special physique.
When he was a research body in the Divine Blood Pavilion, he was rated as Grade A. He could swallow all kinds of animal blood and elixirs, and his potential was endless! "
"He was already completely dead, but after being sent to Grandma Montenegro, he unexpectedly came back to life mysteriously and caused a lot of trouble."
Having said this, Liu Qingda turned to look at Grandma Heishan, with some confirmation in his eyes.
Grandma Heishan narrowed her eyes slightly and said with a bit of surprise in her tone: "Oh? You mean, there is a research body that has resurrected from the dead in my place?"
Liu Qingda nodded heavily and his tone became more and more certain: "Exactly! My subordinates have verified it and it is absolutely true!"
Xu Zhihua's eyes became more intense and his breathing became heavier!
The first-class divine blood research body has been resurrected from the dead. If it can be controlled again, it will definitely be a great achievement that can alarm Xiang Jing!
Xu Zhihua knew in his heart that this resurrected research body must have been successfully cultivated.
That research body must have a heaven-defying ability!
It may even change the future of the entire Prime Minister Empire!
He could no longer maintain his composure, so he immediately pulled Liu Qingda and the three of them with Grandma Heishan to check the information they had with each other.
After a while, Grandma Heishan narrowed her eyes and murmured to herself with shock in her tone: "No wonder, when the Chen family girl ran away, there was a very strange fat boy with her.
There is very little polluted spiritual energy in him, and his divine body is very pure. At first, I was so angry that I couldn't think much about it...
Now it seems that that boy is probably the successful research subject! "
Hearing Grandma Heishan's words, Xu Zhihua's breathing became more rapid. He could no longer suppress the excitement in his heart and roared:
"Chase!"
Before he finished speaking, he took Liu Qingda and left in a hurry.
Heishan Cave, not even a farewell was left.
"Damn it! I missed such a powerful medicine!"
Grandma Heishan looked at the backs of the two people leaving in a hurry and shouted angrily.
That fat boy was her dinner reservation!
It's a pity that the situation was disrupted by the Chen family girl and Chen Guodao, and now he has become the prey of the Wuxiang Sect.
"Fuck the Chen family!"
Grandma Heishan was furious, but she was powerless - the injuries sustained by the zombie had not yet recovered, and she was unable to pursue him at all.
…
As soon as Xu Zhihua left Heishan, he immediately ordered Liu Qingda to summon Wuxiangsi personnel from surrounding counties to quickly search all counties, towns, villages and camps for the whereabouts of the research body and the sword-wielding remnant.
There are a total of thirteen towns under the jurisdiction of Huaishan County, and each town has a chief administrator, that is, a guard.
At the same time, there is a law enforcement department and a non-phase department team.
After receiving Liu Qingda's order, the government officials and Wuxiangsi teams from 13 towns, totaling thousands of people, quickly mobilized.
For a time, the entire Huaishan County was in turmoil and people were in panic.
······
A few days later, Xu Zhihua compiled and analyzed the collected intelligence and quickly locked the target range - within the jurisdiction of Wuqiao Town!
There is news that a zombie is suspected to have appeared in Qingshan Village!
And that zombie's behavior is most likely the sword-wielding remnant they are looking for.
Therefore, Xu Zhihua and Liu Qingda immediately summoned the elite force of Huaishan County, two hundred cavalry, and galloped towards Wuqiao Town.
The horses riding on these two hundred cavalry were not ordinary horses, but black-scaled horses that had been contaminated by spiritual power.
title_en: Volume 1, Chapter 21: Is he still a sword cultivator? Volume 1, Chapter 22: He originally held the sword for the human race
